title: REAR CARPETS & INSULATORS
summary: Rear carpet set behind the seats, all models: the riser carpet on the wall behind the seats (seat back reinforcement), the wheelhouse carpets, and the rear floor carpet around the rear storage compartments, plus a deadener mat and, on coupes, a spacer (View A). The carpets are glued with 51d/51ee adhesive; cut-outs are made on perforation lines for the rear compartment lamp and, on coupes, the storage tray hinge bracket.
